goal: Minimal Franka FLAT-SURFACE pick-place built as a clean chain RELAY stage: a Franka Panda picks ONE cube resting in FRONT of it on a flat static table top (NO conveyor, NO work-surface prop, NO extra workpiece clutter) and drops it into a shallow bin to its front-left. Authored as stage-1 of a robot-diversity SEQUENTIAL chain (#29): a prior stage (CP-84 UR10) stacks one cube at world [0.5,-0.4,0.825], and this template's PickSensor is aligned onto that landing so the Franka picks the relayed cube with the cube DIRECTLY IN FRONT of the arm (no side-reach plan-fail). The chain_gate source_override replaces the placeholder cube with the relayed prim; chain_gate deletes the stage-k placeholder so it cannot collide with the relay.
thoughts:
ROOT-CAUSE FIX (2026-06-17, cont.189): the prior Approach-D author used Franka orientation [0.7071,0,0,0.7071] (+90deg about Z) so the Franka's dexterous FRONT (+X base) pointed to world +Y. But the relayed cube (CP-84 stacks at world [0.5,-0.4,0.825]) sits at world +X of the Franka base -> in base frame the cube was at (~0.0, -0.41) = the Franka's RIGHT SIDE. A side-reach top-down grasp is exactly where cuRobo returns res_None (observed: plan_calls=12, plan_fails=12, last_fail_goal world=[0.51,-0.39,1.12]). FIX: IDENTITY orientation [1,0,0,0] so +X base = +X world = straight at the cube; with the chain offset the cube lands at base (+0.45, 0) = the Franka's dexterous front. Verified-against-code (pick_place.py _build_scene_cfg): inst0/BaseCube is NOT in the Franka collision world (only the rerooted inst1/Table+inst1/Bin are), so the earlier 'BaseCube-as-obstacle' theory was REFUTED -- the plan-fail was the side-reach, not an obstacle.
Geometry (template-local, before the chain offset [0.05,-0.4,0]):
* Franka local [0,0,0.75], identity orientation -> faces +X.
* Placeholder Cube_1 local [0.45,0,0.80] = IN FRONT, under the sensor (so the STANDALONE control is a real front-pick test). chain_gate deletes inst{k}/Cube_1 in the chain (it is not the source; source_override uses inst0 cubes).
* PickSensor local [0.45,0,0.85] -> chain world [0.50,-0.40,0.85] = lands exactly on CP-84's relay [0.5,-0.4,0.825]. TALL z-extent 0.78..0.92 absorbs the rest-height delta.
* Bin local [0.40,0.30,0.75] -> front-left, reach 0.5m, both pick(0.45,0) and place(0.40,0.30) in the front hemisphere.
* Table local centre [0.2,0,0.375] scale [0.9,0.6,0.375] -> top z=0.75; covers Franka, pick, bin. The relay rests on inst0/BaseCube (z 0.825) ABOVE this table top -> no interpenetration.
* belt_path=None -> no conveyor sweep; single placeholder -> no pick-zone clutter; deep walls only on the DEST bin (front-left, clear of the pick).
code:
# Flat static-surface pick cell (NO baseline call -> Table is a namespaceable create_prim).
# cont.190: geometry REPLICATES the PROVEN CP-01 Franka pick regime exactly (orientation +90deg so
# base +X = world +Y; pick 0.40m in FRONT; bin BEHIND). The cont.189 identity-orientation/0.45m-front
# design was MEASURED unreachable (approach pose [.,.,1.12] res_None 12/12 even with zero obstacles);
# CP-01 delivers at 0.40m front + the same hover height, so copy its layout and align via the chain offset.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

# Work table: scale -> half-extents [0.6,0.9,0.375], centre [0,0,0.375] -> TOP z=0.75; covers pick(+y),
# base(0), bin(-y). Raw create_prim -> namespaced /World/inst{k}/Table (no /World/Table clobber).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Table", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, 0.375], scale=[0.6, 0.9, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Table", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# CP-01-PROVEN orientation: +90deg about Z so base +X = world +Y. The pick (world +Y of base) is then
# the Franka's dexterous FRONT, 0.40m out -> the reachable regime CP-01 delivers in.
robot_wizard(
    robot_name="franka_panda",
    dest_path="/World/Franka",
    position=[0, 0, 0.75],
    orientation=[0.7071068, 0, 0, 0.7071068],
)

# ONE placeholder workpiece, 0.40m IN FRONT (local +y) under the PickSensor (so the STANDALONE control
# is a real front-pick test). chain_gate source-overrides to the relayed cube AND deletes this prim in
# the chain so it cannot collide with the relay landing at the same world spot.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.0, 0.4, 0.80], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name=api)
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=["/World/Cube_1"], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_name="rubber")

# Shallow drop bin BEHIND the robot (local -y = base -X), the CP-01-proven place side.
create_bin(prim_path="/World/Bin", position=[0.0, -0.4, 0.75], size=[0.3, 0.3, 0.12])

# TALL PickSensor over the FRONT (+y) pick region: z-extent spans a table-resting cube (0.80) AND a
# relayed cube resting on a prior stage's delivery surface (~0.825).
add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[0.0, 0.4, 0.85], size=[0.08, 0.08, 0.14])

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path=None,
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1"],
    destination_path="/World/Bin",
    drop_targets=[[-0.07, -0.47, 0.80], [0.07, -0.47, 0.80], [-0.07, -0.33, 0.80], [0.07, -0.33, 0.80]],
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Bin"],
)

extension_notes: Authored 2026-06-17 (cont.189) as the clean stage-1 for the UR10->Franka robot-diversity SEQUENTIAL chain (#29). The cont.189 redesign FIXED the side-reach plan-fail (identity orientation, pick in front). REFUTED the earlier 'inst0/BaseCube as Franka obstacle' theory by reading pick_place.py _build_scene_cfg: the Franka static obstacle world is only the rerooted inst1/Table+inst1/Bin (plus the hardcoded /World/Table|ConveyorBelt|Bin which are absent in a composed scene), so a cross-instance support cube is NEVER an obstacle. For a SINGLE source cube with belt_path=None the PickSensor is NOT a pick gate (pick_place.py:6306-6441) -- the cube is admitted by the z-window + reach gates and the sensor is only the cands.sort tie-break; so plan_calls>0 means the cube was admitted and any res_None is a PLAN issue (reach/orientation/collision), read ctrl:last_fail_goal. MULTI-SUB NOTE: CP-84 is target_source='curobo' so its _curobo_pp_sub_World_inst0_UR10 stays live across stage1 -> _sibling_keepout_cuboids() (pick_place.py:5128) auto-adds the inst0 UR10 body as a hard cuRobo cuboid for the Franka (the UR10-clip residual is auto-mitigated). Residual run-time risks: cube-on-BaseCube grip-slip (the relay is balanced on a 5cm cube) and the standard cuRobo plan/drop stochastic tail -- measure under N-of-M.
